name: Original fixed pavilion acceptance task
purpose: Integration benchmark, not a real client approval or a professional building certificate
brief: 6x5m small pavilion; continuous entry floor; four rises to a 0.72m raised platform; finished wall/slab/openings, an open door, window, solid guards, table and ceiling lamp; editable native model and downstream plan/section data.
